title: Joining Thelonious Monk: no rehearsals
summary: Monk calls Sam, refuses to rehearse, and Charlie Rouse says to keep bugging him; Monk's extra bars are hard.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: So when I was down there, checking in at home, and uh, and they said a man called here named Thelonius Monk, for you. We told him that you would be back next week, and he said get in touch with him as soon as you get back. I say Thank Goodness, I will. I'm jumping out of the frying pan into the pot now. I'm going with Mr. Thelonius Monk, I didn't know this man was-out,you know.

So I come back man, call Thelonius, and say "Yeah I want you to join my band he say". "I say fine." "Yes sir. I say, uhm, are we going to have some rehearsals?" He say, "I don't rehearse. Bam, hung up." You know, I say, God dog, you don't rehearse, how I'm gonna do, what I'm gonna do in this band, Christ man, so uhm so I call Charlie Rouse up man, and I say man, what's happening man, and Rouse is bad, I don't know he say, I say well how do you learn the song? He say man, I just keep bugging Thelonius until he try to get whatever I can out of it, so he said, man, so I said well let's go round to Thelonius' house, talking about rehearsal and stuff and he looked at me and say, "You supposed to be a bass player, you said you'se professional bass player, jazz bass player, so you don't need no rehearsing. You can hear, can't you?"
I says God dog, what is this I got into now?

Here I go again man, all this stuff; so finally we play the first gig man, and I'm scuffing it trying to play this man's music,man, and his music is very, very difficult,man, because he uhm, he got some extra bars, you know, in some of his songs and you'd have to count them bars, if you don't count them bars, them bars, them extra bars,
